title: Knee Pain Physiotherapy at Home in Lucknow
content:
Knee Pain Physiotherapy at Home in Lucknow


Knee pain is one of the most common health problems affecting people of all ages. Whether your pain is caused by arthritis, a ligament injury, sports activity, or knee replacement surgery, Dr Jhatka Medicare provides expert Home Physiotherapy in Lucknow to help you recover safely and comfortably at home.

Why Does Knee Pain Happen?

Knee pain can occur due to many reasons, including:

• Osteoarthritis (Joint Wear & Tear)

• Knee Ligament Injury

• Meniscus Tear

• Knee Replacement Surgery Recovery

• Sports Injury

•Age-Related Knee Pain

How Home Physiotherapy Helps

Home physiotherapy helps reduce pain, improve flexibility, strengthen muscles around the knee, and restore normal walking and daily activities without visiting a clinic.

Our Knee Physiotherapy Services

At Dr Jhatka Medicare, our qualified BPT & MPT physiotherapists provide:

• Knee Pain Assessment

• Manual Therapy

• Strengthening Exercises

• Balance & Walking Training

• Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

• Arthritis Knee Pain Management

Benefits of Choosing Dr Jhatka Medicare

• Affordable Home Healthcare Services

Frequently Asked Questions

Most patients need 7–15 sessions, depending on the severity of the condition.
